All Implemented Interfaces:
ca.uhn.fhir.model.api.IElement, Serializable, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBase, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseCoding, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseDatatype, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseElement, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.ICompositeType, org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.ICoding
public class FhirCoding extends org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Coding
This class is a subclass of Coding. Therefore it contains reference to a code defined by a terminology or ontology.
It contains functionalities for converting CDA R2 CD, CDA R2 CE and CDA R2 CS into HL7 FHIR Coding and vice versa.
